question: After the branch is repaired to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should maintainers require live Matrix/Element proof before merge or accept the contributor's in-memory Matrix adapter proof?
rationale: The external-PR proof gate expects real behavior evidence, but the contributor says they lack Matrix homeserver credentials and the source-path proof exercises the relevant OpenClaw functions.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.

options.title: Accept source-path proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly waive live transport proof after the duplicate option is removed.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.
